summary: Versatile Software Engineer with 8+ years of Python and 4+ years of TypeScript experience developing AI-driven applications, scalable cloud-integrated pipelines, and robust testing frameworks. Proven track record deploying Google Cloud platforms (Vertex AI, Firestore), engineering data workflows with numpy and pandas, and mentoring junior engineers across high-reliability systems.

experience.title: Chief Consulting Engineer
bullets: Architected full-stack applications and cloud services using TypeScript, Next.js, and Google Cloud Platform (Vertex AI, Firestore, Cloud Storage).
Engineered the 'Hire Me' AI Tools Suite using Vertex AI, deploying specialized tools for structured evaluation, text synthesis, and automated analysis.
Built 'Photo Fun,' an AI transformation service using Google Gemini and Vertex AI hosted on Vercel with a Firebase/Firestore backend.
Implemented an interactive educational demo of Pedro Domingos' Tensor Logic bridging neural and symbolic AI paradigms with a TypeScript frontend and Rust/Axum backend.
Created comprehensive end-to-end and unit testing pipelines using Vitest and Playwright with AI-assisted workflows via Cursor and Claude Code.

experience.title: Test Engineer III - Embedded Software
bullets: Engineered automated test software in Python for medical point-of-care test instruments.
Designed and implemented full remote access frameworks enabling continuous real target testing and continuous integration.
Authored developer API reference documentation hosted on internal web systems using custom Sphinx extensions.
Executed 9 verification test suites and manual regression tests for USB-based instrument firmware update infrastructure.

experience.title: Software Development Engineer in Test (SDET)
bullets: Developed an object-oriented Python test framework mediating between cloud servers and hardware endpoints to verify OTA updates.
Architected scalable test procedures with three levels of logging and two levels of configurable stop-on-fail execution control.
Engineered concurrent application log following during live execution using paramiko, Selenium, and custom Python modules.
Designed comprehensive YAML configuration files for dynamic test parameterization within an Ubuntu Linux and GitLab environment.

experience.title: Sr. Diagnostic Software Engineer
bullets: Created telemetry event data log analysis and visualization pipelines using Python, numpy, pandas, and matplotlib across multi-dimensional system data.
Constructed SQL databases for parsed, cleaned telemetry streams and generated time-series plots correlated with hardware status words.
Developed synchronous environmental data collection and logging software in Python to correlate physical and system-level test logs in time.
Configured standalone production test stations running RHEL 6.3 and wrote Python software for embedded BeagleBone Black controllers on Debian Linux.

experience.title: Sr. Software Engineer
bullets: Developed high-speed timing calibration algorithms for a 192-channel digital ATE instrument using C++ and custom Python scripts.
Generated custom digital pin XML timing patterns using Python automation to drive high-speed instrumentation tests.
Co-designed four production implementations of a generic parallel binary search object.

experience.title: Sr. Test Program Engineer
bullets: Developed functional and performance test infrastructure on Linux utilizing C, Perl, and SQL databases for SSD interface validation.
Built Linux PC-based test platforms with physical enumeration of DUT serial numbers to preserve test state across power cycles.
Mentored a new college graduate engineer in test development methodologies and platform automation.

additionalSections.title: Technical Focus & Domain Expertise
additionalSections.content: Deep background in automated test methodology, telemetry parsing, and diagnostic algorithms. Professional focus includes applying machine learning to hardware fault isolation, time-series anomaly detection, property-based testing in Python, and full-stack cloud AI application engineering.
